name: Wrestling
overview: The Scriptures portray wrestling both literally and figuratively, illustrating spiritual struggle and perseverance. Jacob’s night-long wrestling with a mysterious man, resulting in a physical injury yet spiritual blessing, symbolizes the believer’s intense engagement with God and personal transformation (Genesis 32:24-25). The use of wrestling imagery in Rachel’s naming of Naphtali reflects the reality of conflict and prevailing through struggle (Genesis 30:8). Additionally, Psalm 144:1 and Proverbs 27:17 emphasize the strengthening and sharpening that come through conflict and mutual challenge, highlighting the necessity of divine strength and godly fellowship in spiritual wrestling.
